decisions.reason: The coolant pressure booster extends the firm's core coolant management knowledge, and its in-house R&D lets it interpret early results and refine the product.
The cleaning centrifuge builds on established filtration expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate market feedback and improve it.
Coolant nozzles are a multi-model line closely tied to the firm's coolant systems, which gives it strong absorptive capacity and natural complementarity.
Scraper belt chip conveyors sit close to the firm's conveying know-how, and its R&D supports learning from early results.
The magnetic belt chip conveyor builds directly on established conveyor competence for metalworking customers.
The hinged belt chip conveyor is a core material-flow product that is close to existing knowledge, making it easy to evaluate and improve.
